keyHistoryEntry.description: A snapshot of the members array at a previous rotation. Preserved so remaining members can still decrypt documents uploaded under older group keys.

main.description: A named keyring for group-based access control, or one segment of a keyring supersede chain. Contains a group symmetric key wrapped to each member's DID public key. Manager-authority only writes; membership, rotation, rename, and relocation all go through supersede. The canonical keyring is the head of the chain — whichever record has no successor pointing at it. Analogous to git-crypt's named keys, but with the chain as the authority structure rather than a single canonical owner.

opakeVersion.description: Schema version for the at.opake.* namespace. Clients should reject records with a version they do not understand.

algo.description: The symmetric algorithm the group key is intended for.

supersedes.description: AT-URI of the prior canonical keyring this record supersedes, if any. Absent on the genesis keyring. Indexers walk this back-edge to verify the chain and check that the supersede was authored by a manager of the prior keyring.

workspaceId.description: The genesis keyring URI of this workspace's chain — the stable workspace identity across rotations and membership changes. Absent on the genesis keyring (where this record's own URI is the workspace ID). Present on every supersede so any reader can resolve workspace identity without walking the chain back to genesis.

members.description: Each member's wrapped group key and workspace role.

rotation.description: Key rotation counter. Increment when the group key is rotated (e.g. after revoking a member). Documents should reference the rotation they were encrypted under.

keyHistory.description: Previous rotation snapshots. Each entry preserves the members array from before a rotation so remaining members can still unwrap group keys for pre-rotation documents.

encryptedMetadata.description: Encrypted keyring metadata (name, description). Encrypted with the group key so only members can read it.
